evidence.reason: The guard remains purely lexical at line 103. On a case-insensitive POSIX volume, a sessions path that differs from the workspace only by casing is treated as outside (`../repo/sessions`) even though it resolves inside the model-editable tree. `realpathSync` does not guarantee canonical casing there, so the intended outside-workspace rejection is bypassed. This is an ordinary correctness defect in existing guard behavior; the contract is silent on this internal detail but does not authorize the bypass. Comparing existing ancestors by device/inode while keeping the lexical rejection is the smallest compatible fix.
